the four known PMCAA, PMCA3, PMCA4 and PMCA2 genes are expressed in every region of the brain, that all four genes are alternatively spliced at two hotspots, A and C, and that the pattern of splice variants differs between regions.

(i) the expression of all PMCAs in the brain is not homogeneous and (ii) the pattern of PM-CA alternative splicing is not uniform, with some areas showing the expression of the 'default' variants and some areas showing the presence of all alternative splice variants.

the four PMCA isoforms are expressed in all brain regions and that the distribution of alternative splicing variants is region-specific and may be correlated with different physiological demands in the various brain sub-regions.
